limits: Validated ordinary visible percentage, em and parsed viewport-unit reads/conversions. Hidden-subtree provider completion, unsafe/initial/detached documents, arbitrary fonts, reentrancy/lifetime, IEEE arithmetic, cross-platform behavior and performance remain outside this evidence.
